==Descriptions==
'''Mars''' was a map which, as the name suggests, is located on Mars. The map was stated to be released in the [[Area 51 Event]] alongside [[Crossroads]] and [[Abyssal Trench]], though unlike the two it was never actually added.

==Design & Path==
'''Mars''' is a map located on the planet Mars. The entire map mostly consists of a flat ground built out of red rock with some occasional cliffs. A few metal structures are located on the map.

The path started with a portal and ended at a tower. It would take a path in between the cliffs and buildings present on the map.
